name: Monarch Money
verdict_reason: Actual Budget is the best self-hosted budgeting tool ever made: local-first, envelope budgeting, fast sync server. Bank imports work through SimpleFIN Bridge ($1.50/mo) — still 90% cheaper than Monarch.
what_you_lose: Investment tracking is thin in Actual — it budgets cash flow

what_broke: Compose re-verified 2026-08-31: boot to healthy in 14s (down from 21s on initial run — image layer cache). actual-budget last commit 2026-08-29, v26.8.1 released 2026-08-07; project active. No new friction. Full workflow timing from original log stands.
